purpose: Structured database for CCP routing evaluation, inspection zones, routing categories, protector references, saved inspections, and Excel report export.
source_notes: Based on CCP routing evaluator requirements and SCA_F153_VLO_DDVLO inspection-zone reference used in the system.
Use the latest approved CCP routing manual/document if there is conflict.
This database supports the system; deterministic rule engine remains authoritative for calculated grades.

1.name: Inner side of hood and hood-latch area
1.description: Inspect the inner hood surface and the hood-latch area.

2.name: Engine compartment left side
2.description: Inspect the left side outside the engine, up to the air-input filter.

3.name: Engine-to-front-panel area
3.description: Inspect the area between the engine and front panel, including the fan unit.

4.description: Inspect the engine area, including the turbo and exhaust.

5.description: Inspect the area between the engine and bulkhead.

6.name: Engine compartment right side
6.description: Inspect the right side outside the engine, up to the air-input grille.

custom_system.label: Other / new system
custom_system.behavior: If selected, show a New system text input and require the worker to type the new system name. Also allow/require a custom routing type so future findings can be saved and exported.

custom_routing_type.label: Other / new routing type
custom_routing_type.report_behavior: Save typed custom routing type and export it into Routing type column.

contact.description: Use when a PCW physically touches another part, edge, surface, protector or component.
pcw_types: Electric cable / wiring 8 mm or above

custom_pcw_type.label: Other / new PCW type
custom_pcw_type.behavior: If selected, show a New PCW type text input and require the worker to type the new PCW type. Save the typed wording in the inspection record. Use generic 'other' behavior in the deterministic rule engine unless a future special rule is added.

special_cases: Contact at the end piece of a protector

proximity.description: Use when the PCW is extremely close to another part; the evaluator uses the below-3-mm trigger.

heat.description: Use when a hot component can damage routing, wiring or connectors without direct contact.
pcw_groups: Metal tube / plastic hose or tank / control cable

types.label: Convolute - non split / split / anti-noise / double hull
Sharp edge of cut end / opening of convolute

feature_classification_definitions.safety: Safety and braking, steering, fuel system regulation, SCR circuit, battery/starter positive wiring and high-voltage orange cables.
feature_classification_definitions.non_safety: Water, air, oil and other non-safety pipes; general wiring except battery/starter positive wiring; ground wires and 48V purple cables.

movement_definitions.rotation: High-speed rotation from rotating mechanical parts such as fan, pulley, belt or similar rotating components.
movement_definitions.relative: Movement between components on areas with different movement conditions, for example body vs suspension, engine vs body or exhaust routing.
movement_definitions.vibration: Small oscillating movement caused by engine, road, suspension or component vibration.

columns.header: Clearance mini acceptable + put the source of the value in DT

photo_export_rules.server_export: Embed photos in Excel report Photos column using openpyxl.
photo_export_rules.local_file_export: Do not embed photos in direct index.html export if Excel single-file-web-page error occurs. Use server export for photo-in-cell report.

layout.2_photos: side by side inside Photos cell

session_behavior.new_session_button: During the same visit, New session continues to Session 2, Session 3 and so on.
session_behavior.concern_numbering: Concern number starts at 1 for each new active session.
session_behavior.saved_table_scope: Saved inspections table shows current session only.

saved_inspection_schema.photoDataList: array of compressed photo data URLs
saved_inspection_schema.initialGrade: S | A | B | C | No grade
saved_inspection_schema.grade: S | A | B | C | No grade
